entities.name: Great Famine (An Gorta Mór)
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The catastrophic potato blight devastated a population dependent on a single crop. Approximately 1 million died and 1 million emigrated in the worst years (1845–52). British government policy, workhouses, coffin ships, and the fundamental reshaping of Irish rural society.
